title: serial op count: ~0.4 us/op - granularity does not explain slow graphs

rewrite.from: one fat op (6.6 GF single CONV_2D)
rewrite.to: 3000 serial Conv+ReLU pairs of equal total FLOPs
rewrite.equivalence_evidence: matched-FLOPs, different graphs (a cost-model measurement, not a rewrite to apply)

measurement.probe: probe_grmono vs probe_gr3000; curve: N=10/100/1000/3000 = 0.52/0.54/1.19/1.69 ms (0.5 ms invoke floor + ~0.4 us/op)

scope: 1x1 conv chains c=32; the split form BEATS the monolith 1.6x. Kills 'zipformer is slow because 3085 ops' (would account for ~1.5 ms of ~82)
notes: GPU control: gr300 2.63 ms vs NPU 0.61 - the NPU is the better fine-granularity engine here
